name: country
description: "Country code for [country]" / "what's the ISO code for [X]" / "alpha-2 / alpha-3 for [country]" / "look up country [DE / FR / JP]" — ISO 3166-1 country record by name, alpha-2 ("US"), alpha-3 ("USA"), or numeric ("840") code. Returns full record with all code forms + official name. Use whenever you need a canonical country identifier.

name: subdivisions
description: "States / provinces / regions of [country]" / "ISO 3166-2 codes for [DE / US / FR]" — list ISO 3166-2 subdivisions (states, provinces, regions, prefectures) for a country (pass alpha-2 like "US" or "DE"). Use for forms, validation, and admin-level data.

name: language
description: "Language code for [X]" / "ISO 639-3 / 639-1 for [language]" / "what's the code for [English / Spanish]" — language record (ISO 639-1/639-3) by name or code. Returns 2-letter, 3-letter, bibliographic forms.

name: currency
description: "Currency code for [X]" / "ISO 4217 for [currency]" / "what code is [USD / EUR / JPY]" — currency record (ISO 4217) by name or code. Returns alpha-3 + numeric code + official name. Use for finance, accounting, multicurrency systems.

name: script
description: "Writing system code for [X]" / "ISO 15924 for [Latin / Cyrillic / Han]" / "script code lookup" — writing system record (ISO 15924) by name or 4-letter code. Use for typography, font selection, i18n.

name: list
description: "List all countries / currencies / languages / scripts" / "all ISO codes for [kind]" — dump every record in one ISO list, optionally filtered. Pass kind="countries" / "languages" / "currencies" / "scripts" / "subdivisions". Use for enumeration or building dropdowns.
